QuestInfo.name: [Carcion] Stealing From the Gods
QuestInfo.0: Just like the Turtles, the Snakes are suffering from the poison in the water. Use the #bWorld Heart#k to absorb the corrupting energy.
QuestInfo.1: Just like the Turtles, the Snakes are suffering from the poison in the water. Use the #bWorld Heart#k to absorb the corrupting energy.
QuestInfo.2: With the World Heart, you cured the poisoned Anima. Afterwards, Hinya told the story of what had happened to the island. According to her, the Turtle Anima are the real traitors. Are the High Flora pitting both sides against each other?
